Octabam v0.4, built from tag `v0.4` (`9e2545bc`). Octatrack OS 1.40C patched with the `octabam` remix; the build runs in the browser on your own copy of 1.40C.

Build and install: https://sambanks.github.io/octabam/web-builder.html

Changes from v0.3:
- SHATTER added on FX2: fold, clip, bit and sample-rate crush, chaotic feedback. Loaded on demand like SPECTRUM, CHARACTER and MODULATION (#1021).
- COMPRESSOR is the side-chain compressor again (SIDECHAIN_COMPRESSOR, loaded on demand). Page 2's KEY reads `--` while its code is not loaded (#1026).
- OCTA303: at most two machines in a Part. A third shows `MAX 2 OCTA-303` and stays FLEX; a Part loaded with more keeps its first two (#1008).
- USB MIDI in: a transfer that completed between two reads of the endpoint status was dropped, and the next replayed stale events. ENDPTCOMPLETE is now read once (#1029, reported by xynta).
- USB MIDI out: a burst past 256 bytes is no longer cut. A 4 KB ring sits behind the accumulator (#1036, design by xynta).
- Stock DELAY reads its table up to entry 1023 alongside SCALE QUANTIZER (#1023).
- PLOCKS P2: empty files keep their header (#1010).
- RECORDER LOOP FIX memo update (#1014); MUTE_MODES pinned at `bb9bead` (#1022).

Measured: OCTA303's CPU share on Sam's MKII, 2 Nov 2026 (meter only): idle 25.3 %, 2 machines 65.5 %, 4 machines 83.2 %. That measurement is why the limit is two.

Not run on a unit: this composition, image `OCTABAM04`. The remix's proof status is CHECK (port gates only); the last hardware suite ran on `OCTABAMR3`, without SIDECHAIN_COMPRESSOR or SHATTER. SHATTER has not run under the port either.

Superseded by v0.5.

No Elektron files are attached. The web builder patch is `docs/site/builder/patches/octabam.obp` in the repository, added after the tag in `9adb10dc` (sha256 `9159aca19b927478c9be8ebe5f86028c0f1a6f43c80d54d69fc739d753362977`).
